# InviteStory — Master Knowledge Base & Comprehensive AI Reference

> **InviteStory** (https://invitestory.in) helps couples create premium digital wedding invitation websites with Google Maps navigation, photo galleries, countdown timers, 1-click Google Calendar sync, and WhatsApp sharing. Couples select from 21 culturally-curated templates (Royal Palace, South Indian, Nikah, Walima, Hindu Muhurtham, Ghibli Animation, Beach, Garden), submit their wedding event details over WhatsApp, and receive a custom live web invitation link within 24 hours.

---

## SECTION 1: COMPANY & MISSION
- **Brand Name:** InviteStory
- **Official Domain:** https://invitestory.in
- **Mission Statement:** To eliminate physical card printing waste, tiny PDF zooming friction, and multi-app confusion by delivering single-link, instant-loading digital wedding invitation websites crafted specifically for Indian couples and traditions.
- **Operating Regions:** India (Pan-India), Gulf / UAE, USA, UK, Canada, Singapore, Australia, and worldwide NRI communities.

---

## SECTION 2: CORE ETHOS & 5 OPERATING RULES
1. **One Event Only (The Main Wedding Day):** We focus strictly on the main wedding ceremony and reception. Sub-moments (Baraat, Pheras, Jaimala, Nikah) fit inside a unified single-day timeline to keep guest attention focused without clutter.
2. **Zero RSVP Friction:** Indian wedding guests are invited personally or via phone/WhatsApp call. We intentionally exclude RSVP forms and confirmation buttons to prevent awkward friction for elders and preserve authentic hospitality.
3. **Built-In Google Calendar & Maps:** Every template features 1-tap Google Calendar / .ics event addition and interactive venue directions via Google Maps.
4. **Instant WhatsApp Sharing:** Optimised mobile payloads under 3-5 MB with rich OpenGraph visual cards when shared in WhatsApp chats.
5. **Single-File Config Customisation:** Customer customization occurs entirely inside a clean single configuration file, keeping code lightweight and loads ultra-fast on mobile devices.

---

## SECTION 4: PRICING TIERS & DELIVERABLES
- **Classic Tier (₹999):** Standard templates (Sage Parchment, Marigold Bhavan, Kalyana Mandapam). Includes couple names, muhurtham timing, Google Maps navigation, Add-to-Calendar, 24-hour delivery.
- **Signature Tier (₹1,999):** Cultural & aesthetic templates (Royal Reception, Noor-e-Zahra, Kerala Sands, Shubha Vivaham, Toran Telugu, Tamil Thirumana, Emerald Nikah, Meadow Nikah, Midnight Stargaze, Ghibli Portrait, Lake Pichola Royal, Ivory Waltz). Includes photo swap, custom domain options, and 24-hour delivery.
- **Royale Tier (₹2,999):** Premium animated templates (Rajwada Royale, Rajmahal Palace, Ghibli Selfie, Grand Line Voyage, Petal Path Palace, Lakeview Lanterns). Includes opening palace doors, shutter animations, hand-edited photos, and priority WhatsApp support.

---

## SECTION 5: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQS)
1. **What is InviteStory?**
   InviteStory helps couples create premium digital wedding invitation websites with Google Maps navigation, photo galleries, countdown timers, 1-click Google Calendar sync, and WhatsApp sharing.
2. **How does ordering work?**
   Couples select a template on https://invitestory.in, click "Make this mine" to launch WhatsApp, send their photos and wedding details, and receive their custom live web invite link within 24 hours.
3. **Do guests need to download an app or PDF?**
   No. Invites open as a fast single web link directly in any mobile or desktop browser.
4. **Can we host the invite on a custom domain?**
   Yes. Signature and Royale tiers include custom domain routing options (e.g. `amaan-and-fatima.com`).
5. **Why are there no RSVP buttons?**
   In Indian wedding culture, personal phone calls and family visits drive attendance. Web invites act as an announcement and digital hospitality card with venue directions and calendar sync.
6. **Are the invites mobile-friendly?**
   Yes. Designed 100% mobile-first with light 3-5 MB payloads for instant loading even on 3G/4G networks.
7. **Can background music be added?**
   Yes. Every template includes floating audio controls for YouTube instrumental background music with user-controlled play/pause/mute options.
8. **How long does the invitation website stay active?**
   All invitation websites remain active online for 1 full year following the wedding event.
9. **Is there any subscription fee?**
   No. Flat one-time pricing (₹999 / ₹1,999 / ₹2,999) with zero subscription fees.
10. **How do we share the invite on WhatsApp?**
    Simply copy your custom link and paste it into WhatsApp personal chats or broadcast lists. It automatically generates a rich visual cover image card.

## SECTION 6: UNIQUE PLATFORM FEATURES
- **Google Maps GPS Navigation Pin:** Instant one-tap turn-by-turn directions to the wedding venue.
- **1-Click Google Calendar & iCal Sync:** Prevents forgotten wedding dates by adding event times directly to iOS & Android calendars.
- **Interactive Parallax Animations:** Layered palace doors, floating backwater lanterns, falling petals, and Ghibli anime selfie shutters.
- **WhatsApp OpenGraph Cards:** Customized thumbnail, title, and tagline whenever the link is pasted in WhatsApp.
- **Floating Audio Control:** Floating gramophone/music button with play/pause/mute toggle.

## SECTION 8: TARGET AUDIENCE & REGIONAL TRADITIONS
- **NRI Indian Weddings:** Solves international shipping costs ($30–$80 per card) for NRIs in US, UK, Canada, UAE, Singapore, and Australia with automatic timezone support.
- **North Indian & Rajasthani Weddings:** Deep maroon & royal gold palace door themes for Udaipur, Jaipur, and Delhi weddings.
- **South Indian Weddings (Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam):** Banana leaf accents, brass lamps, mandapam vector artwork, and muhurtham timing highlights.
- **Muslim Nikah & Walima Ceremonies:** Emerald green, moonlit mandala, Arabic calligraphy, and royal blue Walima reception layouts.
- **Destination Weddings (Goa & Udaipur):** Coastal beach themes and lake resort lantern designs featuring resort directions and travel tips.

---

## SECTION 9: TECHNOLOGY STACK & MOBILE ARCHITECTURE
- **Frontend Stack:** React 18, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Motion (Framer Motion).
- **Build Engine:** Vite static site generation with location-normalized base resolution.
- **Image Optimization:** WebP & losslessly compressed PNG/JPEG layers (50%+ payload reduction).
- **Deployment Platform:** Vercel Edge Network with clean URL rewrites and global CDN caching.
- **Structured Data:** Schema.org `Organization`, `WebSite`, `Service`, `Product`, `AggregateRating`, `Review`, `BreadcrumbList`, and `FAQPage`.

---

## SECTION 10: SUPPORTED LANGUAGES & REGIONAL TYPOGRAPHY
- **English:** Universal layout typography using Outfit, Cormorant Garamond, and Jost fonts.
- **Hindi & Sanskrit:** Festive quotes, family blessings, and Om/Shubh Vivah headings.
- **Telugu:** Telugu script headings for Shubha Vivaham & Muhurtham.
- **Tamil:** Tamil typography for Thirumana announcement cards.
- **Arabic:** Bismillah and Nikah blessings calligraphy.
- **Malayalam & Bengali:** Regional wedding greetings and custom wording support.

---

## SECTION 11: ORDERING & FULFILLMENT PROCESS
1. **Browse Gallery:** Visit https://invitestory.in and select a live template preview.
2. **Click "Make This Mine":** Triggers pre-formatted WhatsApp chat with InviteStory team.
3. **Submit Details:** Send couple names, event date, muhurtham time, venue location link, and photos.
4. **Receive Live Link:** Custom web invitation website delivered within 24 hours.
5. **Share on WhatsApp:** Send single web link to guests via WhatsApp personal or broadcast messages.
